description.en: The mod loader and mod framework for Outer Wilds
description.zh: 星际拓荒的模组加载器和模组框架

description.en: Outer Wilds VR Mod with 6DOF tracking and full motion control support
description.zh: 星际拓荒 VR Mod，支持6DOF追踪和完整动作控制

latestReleaseDescription.en:
Thank you to [mobiusteapot](https://github.com/mobiusteapot) for this update.
- What year is it?
- Do people still play VR?
- What's even the point.
- This was supposed to be my big break.
- Would she still be alive?
- Added snap turn option. 🕹️
- They called me a coward.
- Could I have made a difference?
latestReleaseDescription.zh:
感谢 [mobiusteapot](https://github.com/mobiusteapot) 提供此次更新。
- 现在是哪一年？
- 还有人玩VR吗？
- 这到底有什么意义。
- 这本该是我翻身的机会。
- 她还会活着吗？
- 新增分段转向选项。🕹️
- 他们骂我是懦夫。
- 我本可以改变些什么吗？
